common.name: read_text_file
common.description: Read a UTF-8 text file. Use for past recipe JSONLs, audit JSONs, and memory files. Large files are truncated. Published memory is read-only. During exploration, you may write only to your current memory inbox. Memory for other robots is unavailable.

common.name: write_text_file
common.description: Write a UTF-8 text file (creates parent dirs). Use this to save the working recipe JSONL and the final audit JSON at the end of a successful run. Published memory is read-only. During exploration, you may write only to your current memory inbox. Memory for other robots is unavailable.

common.name: list_dir
common.description: List files in a directory (non-recursive). Default = {{output_dir}}. Use to inspect the working directory or discover existing resource files. Published memory is read-only. During exploration, you may write only to your current memory inbox. Memory for other robots is unavailable.

common.name: finish
common.description: Call when the task is complete or unrecoverable. Halts the agent loop. Save any artifacts (recipe, audit) BEFORE calling finish.

summary.description: Short natural-language summary of the run.

libero.name: reset
libero.description: EXPLORE MODE ONLY. Abandon the current episode and restore the same initial scene. Archive the failed attempt first and state which strategy lever will change in the next attempt.

reason.description: Why this episode is unrecoverable and what will change.

libero.name: view_env_state
libero.description: Read one recorded state and its observation artifacts. Step -1 selects the latest entry. Embeds policy, agentview, and wrist images when available. Use the calibration-frame images for pixel back-projection; JSON state alone is not enough. Use agentview for global tabletop layout and object locations; use wrist for close-range details near the gripper, occlusions, and container/cabinet interiors.

libero.name: move_to
libero.description: Scripted EEF servo to a world-frame XYZ target via the OSC controller. Holds orientation (use rotate_wrist / rotate_pitch / move_pose to reorient). gripper: -1 = open, +1 = close. NEVER command a single move_to with |Δxy| > 0.30 — OSC flips IK and the run corrupts; split long traversal into 2-3 mid waypoints at carry z.

xyz.description: World-frame target [x, y, z] in meters

step_clip.description: Per-step Δxyz cap before action_scale, m (default 0.025)

target_yaw.description: Optional world-frame yaw target in radians

libero.name: pi0_pick
libero.description: Pi0.5 closed-loop pick. Use it for the grasp; YOU then do every move_to and release. Use modest max_chunks and verify the grasp from EEF lift, gripper closure, and available images.

prompt.description: Pi0 prompt (e.g. 'pick up the akita black bowl').

lift_thresh.description: EEF post-descent ascent threshold for success, m (default 0.05)

libero.name: pi0_doubled
libero.description: Pi0.5 closed-loop contact skill for non-pick interactions (e.g. stove/knob/button/short push). Returned success/task_success only mirrors official termination; for intermediate contact skills, success=false does not necessarily mean the contact interaction failed. Inspect image/state evidence. Do not use it as a general pick/place shortcut.

prompt.description: Contact-skill prompt, e.g. 'turn on the stove'.

libero.name: release
libero.description: Open the gripper for up to max_steps env steps while holding EEF in place. Triggers libero termination if the matching On/In predicate is met.

libero.name: set_gripper
libero.description: Hold the current EEF pose and drive the gripper command for `steps` env steps. Use to firm up a grip mid-carry.

libero.name: rotate_wrist
libero.description: Rotate the wrist around the world Z-axis. Provide either target_yaw (absolute) or delta_yaw (relative). Holds xyz fixed.

libero.name: rotate_pitch
libero.description: Tilt the gripper around the world X-axis. Provide either target_pitch (absolute) or delta_pitch (relative). Holds xyz and yaw fixed. Use before threading the gripper into a narrow opening whose front face normal is along world ±y (e.g. microwave cavity).

libero.name: move_pose
libero.description: Servo position AND orientation (pitch + yaw) SIMULTANEOUSLY. Unlike move_to (holds orientation) + rotate_pitch (holds xyz), this co-varies xyz and wrist tilt every env.step. Use to thread cabinet-front / low-shelf poses where a decoupled position servo drives the wrist into an IK singularity and stalls.

xyz.description: World-frame target [x, y, z] in meters

gripper.description: Gripper command held during the move (default -1)

libero.name: view_camera_meta
libero.description: Read per-step camera calibration metadata from recorded artifacts.

libero.name: segment
libero.description: SAM3 visual segmentation over an existing run artifact. It never renders a new camera view. Provide exactly one text prompt or single positive point. A successful top-ranked mask is projected through the matching world map to produce world_xyz.

point.description: Optional single positive point as [row, col]. Mutually exclusive with prompt.

libero.name: back_project
libero.description:
Back-project a pixel (row, col) to a world XYZ point using the selected camera's precomputed world map. Row 0 = top of image, col 0 = left. Returns world_xyz in meters.

USE THIS to find where an object is in the world — look at the embedded high-resolution image returned by view_env_state to pick a pixel on the target object, then call back_project. The default resolution is high (1024x1024). Pass resolution='low' only for pixels from the embedded/standard 256 image. The pixel coordinates must come from the same camera and resolution requested here. Use camera='agentview' for global tabletop layout and object locations; use camera='wrist' for close-range details near the gripper, occlusions, and container/cabinet interiors. Sample several pixels on the object and median their xy for robustness.

REGION MODE: pass row_range=[r0,r1] and col_range=[c0,c1] instead of row/col to get the midpoint of world xy over that pixel window, with an optional world-z band (z_min, z_max). Use it for the center of a container cavity or flat region, where a single-pixel or mask-median estimate is biased toward an edge/rim.

row.description: Pixel row (0=top) in the selected resolution image.

col.description: Pixel column (0=left) in the selected resolution image.

resolution.description: Coordinate system for row/col (default high). Use low only when row/col came from the embedded/standard 256 image.

row_range.description: Region mode: [r0, r1] pixel row window. Requires col_range.

col_range.description: Region mode: [c0, c1] pixel col window. Requires row_range.

z_min.description: Region mode: keep only pixels with world z >= z_min.

z_max.description: Region mode: keep only pixels with world z <= z_max.

vision.name: read_image
vision.description:
Read a step-scoped image artifact as visual input.

Artifact failures are returned as structured tool errors so a bad
model-supplied name or step does not abort the agent run.

text_only.name: read_image
text_only.description: Acknowledge an image artifact without sending bytes to the model.
